messages:
Noah Kim: Heads-up 1: we're releasing a short explainer video with the benchmark blog next week. Planned publish: 2026-05-12 08:00 PT (EMBARGO). Link to storyboard + script: https://docs.internal/redwood/bench-video
Yara Singh: Nice. Two asks: 1) captions + translated subtitles (FR/DE/JP) ready by T-24h; 2) a one-paragraph media note for editors to accompany the video.
Ben Cho: Video team can deliver captions. ETA: raw captions by 05-11 16:00 PT, translated subs by 05-12 02:00 PT if we prioritize. Want to use automated SRT + human pass.
Leah Ortiz: PressOps: will you want an embargoed preview link (no-download) for top outlets? That would help pre-briefs.
PressOps Bot: We can host an expiring preview link. Recommend T-3h access for top-tier contacts. Will queue sends once Leah provides list. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
legal-bot: Legal note: if the video includes model names or third-party logos, we need clearance. Also avoid comparative claims without the qualifying phrase "in our tests". Please route final cut to legal at least 3 hours before publish.
Noah Kim: Acknowledged. Action items: Ben to upload caption SRTs, Yara to draft the editor note, Leah to provide embargo list. We'll set preview links for T-3h. Ben aim to upload captions by 05-11 16:00 PT.
Yara Singh: Draft editor note: "Attached is an embargoed preview of Redwood Inference's benchmarking explainer video. It summarizes methodology and representative results; full data and methods are linked in the blog post." Will post in the doc for review.
Ben Cho: Uploaded draft SRTs to assets: https://assets.internal/video/bench/2026-05-12. Human pass scheduled tonight.
Leah Ortiz: I'll ping top outlets and ask for T-3h access. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/press/video-ship
Noah Kim: Good progress. I'll post final GO in this thread once legal signs off on the cut (target 05-12 04:30 PT). If any timing slips, we'll delay preview but still keep the blog publish window unless we find factual errors.
